'''2011 Yavin 4 Regionals Tim Simon DS Endor Operations''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Tim Simon]] at [[2011 Yavin 4 Regionals]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Endor Operations / Imperial Outpost|Endor-D-endoroperations.gif}}
* '''Deck name:''' I got Best Picture at 20 without Even Trying!
* '''Username:''' AGLETS
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
